book.name: LUKE
book.title: Id ash d Luke Oꞌohana ab Amjed g Jiosh Alidag

content: Matsh mahsi g Jiosh alidag
Sh am hema d si geꞌe lai wehs ha dahm g jejewed ch hab chehgig Augustus. Sha am hu hebai, tsh id am hab juh g chehanig matsh wehs wo e oꞌohan k wo e kuint g hemajkam heheꞌejel e‑kihhim ab.
Id ash d si wehpeg kuintadag. Kush am hema d kownal Syria jewed ch ed hab chehgig Quirinius.
Tsh am himto g hemajkam ab heheꞌejel e‑kihhim wui matsh wo e oꞌohan k wo e kuint.

Tsh hegai Joseph mash wa am kih Nazareth t am ch atsh wo hohnt g Mary gam hu hih Bethlehem wui am Judea chekshani ch ed nash pi ab d kownalibad David amjedkam. Sh g Davidbad am d kihkam Bethlehem t am.
Tsh g Mary am oi g Joseph. Sh eda e aihim matsh wo bei g e‑mad.

Tsh am dada Bethlehem t am. Sh eda pi am hu ha jeg am koksikud kih ch ed. Tsh heg hekaj am dadhaiwua haꞌichu doakam kih ch ed. Kutsh si e ai. Tsh madt g Mary. Kush heg d wehpegkam ch d cheoj. Kutsh am si i hobino s‑moik ikus ch ed k am heg eda woi mo g haꞌichu doakam am e gegosid.
Mash g kahwal ha nuhkuddam ch anghil ab hehgchulid hegai ali.
Sh am haꞌi dadha g kahwal ha nuhkuddam gam hu jeg ed ch an ha nuhkud g e‑shoshoiga.
Tsh ab haha wabsh ha wui e chehgi g anghil ab dahm kahchim t amjed. Kutsh an si i ton ha wehgaj matsh am e chehgi g Jiosh gewkdag. Kutsh wabsh wohoꞌi e totods.
Sh hab hahawa kaij g anghil, “Pi g am wo shaꞌi e totodsid. Ia ant jiwia mant haꞌichu wo em‑ahgi. K id wehs hemajkam d ha wuikam. T wo si s‑ap e tahtkkad ab amjed.
Idani at am mahsi Davidbad kihhim ed hegai mo d Jiosh si Kehsha mat d wo em‑doꞌibiakamk ch d wo geꞌechu em‑kownaligk.
Kumt id ab wo s‑mahchk mat am wo woꞌok heg eda mo am e gegosid g haꞌichu doakam ch g s‑moik ikuskaj wo e hobinodch.”
Tsh haha wabsh shaꞌi muꞌi anghil ab ha wui i e chehgi wehmaj hegai hema k si neꞌe ch ab hehgchulid g Jiosh ch hab kaij.

content.text: “Ab ach wehsijj hehgchulid g Jiosh an dahm kahchim ch ed.
T hegam mo hohhoꞌidachud g Jiosh an jewed dahm wo e doꞌibia k wo si s‑ap e tahtkkad ab aꞌai e wui.”

content: Neh, bash kaij g anghil ch gam hu hahawa i himto dahm kahchim wui. Sh hab kaij a kahwal ha nuhkuddam ab aꞌai e wui, “Oi g wo hihim. Tt wo hihi am Bethlehem wui k am wo nei hegai matsh am hab e juh mo ab i t‑ahgid g anghil am wehhejed g Jiosh.”
Tsh wa woho am si s‑hohtam hihim k am i ha gahghim k ha cheh. Kush woho am woꞌo g ali heg eda mo am e gegosid g haꞌichu doakam.
Tsh hegam kahwal ha nuhkuddam am hahawa i ahgahi mash has kaij g anghil ab amjed.
Tsh wehsijj hegam mash ha kah ab si has i el mo haschu ha ahgid.
Kush am si oidahim g Mary ch am wabsh hejel i s‑mahch.
Tsh g kahwal ha nuhkuddam gam hu uhpam hihi ab si hehgchulidch g Jiosh natsh pi wehs nei hegai mo haschu am ha ahgid g anghil.
Matsh am e chehch g Jesus
Kush am d i gigiꞌik tash g ali. Kumtsh an pahl hikuch mo d ha‑himdag k hab chehch Jesus matsh wa g anghil ia uꞌapa g ahga mat eda koi woꞌiwua.
Matsh am i dagito g Jesus Jiosh wui

Tsh am i e ai g tash matsh g Mary am wo e chehgi mo kegchudas mat hab masma g Mosesbad an oꞌoha g Jiosh chehanig. Bo chuꞌig matsh heg hekaj gohk wo ha kokda g hohhi o g pap‑loloma k ab wo iagchul Jiosh wui. K hab ep chuꞌig matp d wo cheojk g wehpeg mahsidkam ch ab wo i e dagito Jiosh wui. Tsh heg hekaj am bei g ali k am hihi geꞌe cheopi wui ab Jerusalem t ab.
Sh am hema kih g keli ch hab chehgig Simeon ch ash d si s‑apꞌekam ch ab si has elid g Jiosh ch ash ab si nenida mat wo ha doꞌibia g Tutuligo. Sh g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag ab si wehmaj
ch ash am i tashogi matsh pi wo muh k ab wo ai mat wo nei g Jiosh si Kehsha.
Neh, tsh am i e ai g tash. Tsh am hahawa i tashogi mat am wo i wah geꞌe cheopi ch ed. Kutsh g Joseph ch Mary am uꞌapa g Jesus matsh am hab wo juni mo has i masma d ha‑chehanig.
Tsh g Simeon an koh g ali k ab si e hoꞌigeꞌidahun Jiosh wui hab kaijch.

content.text: Pt ab haha wo i ni‑hiwigi mant wo si s‑ap ni‑taht k ni‑pihhu map hab masma heki hu am ni‑ahgid.
Neh, ni‑wuhpuikaj ani hahawa neid ihda mapt hekaj wo t‑doꞌibia.
Kut wehs hemajkam wo s‑mai ab amjed
nat pi d wo ha‑tonligk g nahnko mahs hemajkam ch ab wo si uhgk i ha bei g m‑hemajkamga.”

content: Neh, bash kaij hegai Simeon.
Sh g Joseph ch Mary si has e tahtk heg hekaj mo has i kaij ab amjed g ali.

Sh hab hahawa kaij g Simeon ab ha wui, “Jiosh at wo wa s‑em‑hoꞌigeꞌel,” ch ash hab ep kaij ab jeꞌej wui, “Neh, ihda ali at g Jiosh am si i kei. Kut muꞌi wo t‑doꞌibia. T wabshaba muꞌijj g t‑wehm Tutuligo pi ab hu wo wohochud k im hu hab wo i e juh. Jiosh at ab wo e chehgi t‑wui id hekaj ali. T muꞌijj wo s‑kehꞌid
k hekaj wo mahsko wua g e‑chegitoidag. Kut g m‑ihbdag wo si s‑koꞌokkad hab waꞌi masma matp hems g is‑pahyo ab wo si m‑chuꞌakad m‑ihbdag ed.” Neh, bash kaij g Simeon.

Sh hema g oks am d Jiosh haꞌichu i tashogiddam ch hab chehgig Anna. Sh g ohgajbad hab chehgig Phanuel ch ab d amjedkamaj g Asherbad. Kush g keligaj ihda Anna muh mash eda d haha wabsh i e wehm kihkam wewaꞌak aꞌahid ab.

Sh am haha d hejel wiꞌikam gigiꞌikko gamai giꞌik (84) aꞌahid ab. Tash oidam ch chuhug oidam ash am haꞌichug geꞌe cheopi t am ch ab si has elid g Jiosh ab wui e hoꞌigeꞌidahunch ch hab al heꞌes haꞌichu koꞌa.

Sh am haꞌichug g ali ch jeꞌej g Joseph wehm. Kutsh am jiwia hegai Anna k ash ab hoꞌigeꞌelid g Jiosh ch am hahawa wehsijj ha ahgid ab amjed g ali hegam mash hab waꞌap nenida matsh g Jiosh wo ha doꞌibia.
Matsh gam hu uhpam hihi Nazareth wui
Neh, kutsh wehs am hab juh hegai mo an oꞌohanas chehanig ch ed k gam hu hahawa uhpam hihi Galilee chekshani wui k am dada e-kih am Nazareth kihhim t am.
Kutsh ab si s-gegokim i geꞌelhi g ali k wabsh shaꞌi haꞌichu s-amichud. Sh g Jiosh pihk elidadag am si e tashogid wehhejed.
Mash eda d wiapoꞌogeꞌel g Jesus ch am hih geꞌe cheopi wui
Wehs ahid ab ash am e wushshad Jerusalem t am matsh wa ha doꞌibia g Jiosh g ha-shohshon ab ha amjed g Egypt t am hemajkam. Kush g Jesus jehj chum hekid am hihhim.
Kush am d i gamai gohk aꞌahidag g Jesus. Tsh am i e ai hegai ha-doꞌibiadag wuhshda. Tsh am ep hihi bekch g Jesus k am haꞌichugkahim mo heꞌes i tash am hab e wua.
Tsh am i kuhgit. Tsh gam hu i e nohnogi uhpam. Tsh eda am waꞌi wih g Jesus Jerusalem t am. Sh g jehjij pi mahch mo pi am hu ha wehmaj
nash pi hab elid mash an wa hebai ha wehmaj g hihimdam mash am muꞌi e wehm hihim. Kush hekaj hemako tash waꞌi chihpia k an chum gahghi ha oidk g e-hajuni ch e-nanꞌaipijju.
Sh eda pi am hu haꞌichug. Kutsh oi wa gam hu uhpam hihi Jerusalem wui mat an wo i gahghi.
Kush am d i waik tash. Tsh ged hu hahawa cheh geꞌe cheopi ch ed. Kush am dak ch ab ha kaiham g s-chu aꞌamichuddam ch ab si haꞌichu ha kakke mash am aꞌaga g Jiosh oꞌohana.
Sh idam ab epai haꞌichu kakke. Kush si s-e mamachim neok ch si s-ap ab uhpam i nodgid g haꞌichu ha-kakkei. Sh wehsijj hegam mash kah ab wabsh i hahaꞌadka si has i e tahtk.
Neh, tsh g Joseph ch Mary hab waꞌap si has i e taht am chehgiok. Sh g jeꞌej hab kaij, “Ni-sulijga, shahchu apt ahgk hab t-juh? Shelkam att nonda g m-ohg wehm pi m-edgidk.”
Kush hab kaij ab ha wui, “Chum am wa s-mahch mant hemho wa am wo haꞌichugk ni-ohg Jiosh kih ed.”
Sh eda pi shaꞌi amichud mo haschu ahgch hab kaij.
Kutsh gam hu hahawa uhpam hih ha wehm Nazareth wui k ab ha wechokahim. Sh g jeꞌej pi hekid shaꞌi pi chegito ihda matsh has e juh.
Neh, kutsh ab si s-gegokam i geꞌehogatahi g Jesus k baꞌich i edagi g amichudadag k ash am si oid g Jiosh chehanig. Kush ab si s-hoꞌigeꞌid g Jiosh. Sh g hemajkam ab si has elid.
